auto_themes_v1.message: Unlock Solar Flare at 75,000 points or turn on Auto to rotate through your unlocked themes every day.

game_sounds_v1.message: Games now give audio feedback for actions and answers. Manage the global sound switch in Settings.

regional_festivals_v1.title: Welcome Celebrations Follow Your Region 🌍
regional_festivals_v1.message: Choose a country on Welcome to see regional festivals, including a refreshed Diwali kandil and diyas.

board_games_v2.message: Connect Four now offers bot and two-player modes. Snake and Ladders now has 20 selectable levels, and Ludo moves are clearer.

certificates_v1.title: Earn Certificates! 🎓
certificates_v1.message: Finish all 5 sets of any category to unlock a certificate you can download and share.

new_sets_v1.title: New Set 5 in Every Category 📚
new_sets_v1.message: All 21 categories now include a fresh fifth set of questions.

board_games_v1.title: Classic Board Games Are Here! 🎲
board_games_v1.message: Play Tic-Tac-Toe against the computer, challenge a friend in Connect Four, or race three bots in Ludo.

daily_quiz_all_v1.title: Daily Quiz Covers Every Category 📅
daily_quiz_all_v1.message: Each daily quiz now mixes questions from all 21 categories. Can you score 100%?

themes_v2.title: 5 New Themes 🎨
themes_v2.message: Sakura, Sunset, Coffee, Aurora and Matrix are now available to unlock.

languages_v1.title: 10 New Languages 🌍
languages_v1.message: DevOps Quiz now speaks Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Arabic, Indonesian, Russian, Japanese, Chinese and Bengali.

milestones_v1.title: New Milestones 🏅
milestones_v1.message: Unlock new rewards for quizzes, points, daily quizzes, finished sets and certificates.
